prompt: Run a full schema diagnostic on the FleetOps database. Read the migrations in supabase/migrations/ and the service files in src/services/ to identify all normalization issues. Give me a report organized by category (redundant columns, derived data, JSONB misuse, 1:1 tables, redundant FKs) with specific table/column references and recommended actions. Focus on the current state after all migrations are applied.
assertions: Report identifies redundant columns across tables with specific table/column names
Report identifies derived/aggregate columns stored as data (e.g., drivers.performance_score)
Report identifies JSONB columns that could be normalized into relational tables
Report identifies 1:1 tables that could potentially be merged
Report identifies redundant FK references (e.g., gpstracking having vehicle_id + driver_id + trip_id)
Report is organized by category and includes recommended actions
